Players Committee card image of [[Black 6]] (original printing), game text: “May add 1 pilot. While Tanbris piloting, power +1. Once per game, may retrieve bottom card of Lost Pile. Your total battle destiny here is +X, where X = this TIE's power - 5.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual2-Dark/large/black6.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
